it: \rForse dovrei limitarmi a fare la modella.

id: \bElesa uses Electric type Pokémon. They are weak aganst only the Ground type.
en: \bElesa uses Electric type Pokémon. They are weak aganst only the Ground type.
it: \bCamelia usa Pokémon di tipo Elettro. Sono deboli solo contro il tipo Terra.

id: \bThey are strong against Flying and Water. Flying, Electric, and Steel moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Flying and Water. Flying, Electric, and Steel moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Volante e Acqua. Anche le mosse Volante, Elettro e Acciaio non fanno loro molto danno.

id: \bBe careful. Elesa is prepared for ground types.
en: \bBe careful. Elesa is prepared for ground types.
it: \bAttento. Camelia è preparata contro i tipi Terra.
\rPreparati a cadere ai piedi della mia bellezza.

id: \rElesa: There will be many people in your life who don't agree with you. Who will try to stop you, oppose you. Never give in to them.
en: \rElesa: There will be many people in your life who don't agree with you. Who will try to stop you, oppose you. Never give in to them.
it: \rCamelia: Nella tua vita ci saranno molte persone che non saranno d'accordo con te. Che cercheranno di fermarti, di ostacolarti. Non cedere mai.

id: \rSorry, let me get back on track. This place usually distracts me and leaves my head wandering. Now let's allow our Pokémon to dazzle on stage.
en: \rSorry, let me get back on track. This place usually distracts me and leaves my head wandering. Now let's allow our Pokémon to dazzle on stage.
it: \rScusa, torniamo a noi. Questo posto di solito mi distrae e mi fa perdere nei pensieri. Ora lasciamo che i nostri Pokémon brillino sul palco.
\rCamelia: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Saetta.

id: \rTM72 contains Volt Switch. If it hits you switch out with an ally.
en: \rTM72 contains Volt Switch. If it hits you switch out with an ally.
it: \rLa MT72 contiene Invertivolt. Se va a segno, chi la usa si scambia con un alleato.

id: \rElesa: On stage you and your Pokémon are dazzling. Light up the league with your determination.
en: \rElesa: On stage you and your Pokémon are dazzling. Light up the league with your determination.
it: \rCamelia: Sul palco tu e i tuoi Pokémon siete abbaglianti. Illumina la Lega con la tua determinazione.
